description: Build a year-by-year amortization / payoff schedule for a loan: total lifetime interest, principal/interest split per period, and a what-if extra-payment accelerator showing months saved and interest saved. Resolves the market rate from real credit-union offers when no rate is provided.

credit_score.description: Optional borrower credit score used to qualify the market offer.

extra_monthly_payment.description: Optional extra principal paid each month. Drives the payoff-acceleration analysis (months saved, interest saved).

product_type.description: Loan product; required only when rate is omitted. Default mortgage.

rate.description: Annual interest rate as a percent (e.g. 6.5). If omitted, the market rate is resolved from real credit-union offers via the decision engine.

state.description: 2-letter US state code; required only when rate is omitted (for market-rate lookup).

term_months.description: Loan term in months, e.g. 360 or 180 (required).

name: build_amortization_schedule

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs the caller did not supply that were filled in with defaults. State these explicitly to the user, since they drive the numbers.

extra_monthly_payment.description: Extra monthly principal in dollars assumed when the caller did not specify it.

baseline.description: The loan as scheduled, with no extra payments.

payoff_months.description: Months to payoff on the scheduled payment, equal to the term.

total_interest.description: Total interest in dollars over the full term with scheduled payments only.

total_paid.description: Principal plus interest in dollars over the full term.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

loan_amount.description: Principal in dollars the schedule amortizes.

market_lender.description: Credit union whose published rate was used when the rate came from market data. Null when the caller supplied the rate.

monthly_payment.description: Scheduled principal-and-interest payment in dollars, excluding any extra payment.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

rate.description: Annual note rate in percent used for the schedule.

rate_source.description: Where rate_used came from: 'provided' means the caller supplied it, 'market' means it was resolved from the best live published rate for this state and product.

reason.description: Why no schedule could be built, present only in that case — e.g. no qualifying market offer for that product and state, in which case supply an explicit rate and retry.

schedule.description: The amortization rows at the requested granularity (per month or per year).

ending_balance.description: Loan balance in dollars remaining at the end of this period.

extra_principal_paid.description: Additional principal in dollars paid during this period beyond the scheduled payment.

interest_paid.description: Interest in dollars paid during this period.

label.description: Human-readable label for the row, e.g. 'Year 1'.

period.description: Sequential index of this row: month number or year number depending on the granularity requested.

principal_paid.description: Scheduled principal in dollars retired during this period; it grows every period as interest falls.

term_months.description: Loan term in months (360 = 30 years, 180 = 15 years, 60 = 5 years).

with_extra.description: The same loan with the caller's extra monthly principal payment applied.

interest_saved.description: Interest in dollars avoided by the extra payment — the headline benefit.

monthly_payment_total.description: Total monthly outlay in dollars including the extra principal.

months_saved.description: Months knocked off the payoff by the extra payment.

payoff_months.description: Months to payoff with the extra payment, shorter than the scheduled term.

total_interest.description: Total interest in dollars paid when the extra payment is made every month.

total_paid.description: Principal plus interest in dollars under the accelerated schedule.
